+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * 32 + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * 32 + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * 32 + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;

+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }

+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }

+        center = above;
+        index += plane;

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * 32 + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }

 using Real = double;
 
+namespace {

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * 32 + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+namespace {

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * 32 + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_X
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_X 32
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectX = STENCIL_DIRECT_X;
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_X
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_X 32
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectX = STENCIL_DIRECT_X;
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)

+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+

+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+

+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+

+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}

+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_X
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_X 32
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectX = STENCIL_DIRECT_X;
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
