+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_X
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_X 32
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectX = STENCIL_DIRECT_X;
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif

+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;

+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4

+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2

+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;

+constexpr int kPairY = 8;

+constexpr int kPairInputY = kPairY + 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputZ = kPairZ + 4;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleX = kPairX + 2;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleY = kPairY + 2;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleZ = kPairZ + 2;

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ, 1)
+void pairedStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real initial[kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ];
+    __shared__ Real middle[kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ];
+
+    const int tid = (threadIdx.z * kPairY + threadIdx.y) * kPairX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int threads = kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ;
+    const int coreX = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kPairX;
+    const int coreY = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kPairY;
+    const int coreZ = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kPairZ;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+
+    for (int linear = tid;
+         linear < kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ;
+         linear += threads) {
+        const int lx = linear % kPairInputX;
+        const int yz = linear / kPairInputX;
+        const int ly = yz % kPairInputY;
+        const int lz = yz / kPairInputY;
+        const int gx = max(0, min(coreX - 2 + lx, nx - 1));
+        const int gy = max(0, min(coreY - 2 + ly, ny - 1));
+        const int gz = max(0, min(coreZ - 2 + lz, nz - 1));
+        initial[linear] = input[static_cast<size_t>(gz) * plane
+                              + static_cast<size_t>(gy) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                              + static_cast<size_t>(gx)];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    for (int linear = tid;
+         linear < kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ;
+         linear += threads) {
+        const int lx = linear % kPairMiddleX;
+        const int yz = linear / kPairMiddleX;
+        const int ly = yz % kPairMiddleY;
+        const int lz = yz / kPairMiddleY;
+        const int gx = coreX - 1 + lx;
+        const int gy = coreY - 1 + ly;
+        const int gz = coreZ - 1 + lz;
+        const int center = ((lz + 1) * kPairInputY + ly + 1) * kPairInputX + lx + 1;
+
+        Real value = initial[center];
+        if (gx > 0 && gx < nx - 1 &&
+            gy > 0 && gy < ny - 1 &&
+            gz > 0 && gz < nz - 1) {
+            value += initial[center - 1];
+            value += initial[center + 1];
+            value += initial[center - kPairInputX];
+            value += initial[center + kPairInputX];
+            value += initial[center - kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
+            value += initial[center + kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
+            value /= 7.0;
+        }
+        middle[linear] = value;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int x = coreX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = coreY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = coreZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1 && z < nz - 1) {
+        const int center = ((threadIdx.z + 1) * kPairMiddleY + threadIdx.y + 1)
+                         * kPairMiddleX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+        Real value = middle[center];
+        value += middle[center - 1];
+        value += middle[center + 1];
+        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX];
+        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX];
+        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
+        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
+        const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                           + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                           + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+        output[index] = value / 7.0;
+    }
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_X
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_X 32
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectX = STENCIL_DIRECT_X;
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+constexpr int kPairX = 32;
+constexpr int kPairY = 8;
+constexpr int kPairZ = 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputX = kPairX + 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputY = kPairY + 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputZ = kPairZ + 4;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleX = kPairX + 2;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleY = kPairY + 2;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleZ = kPairZ + 2;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ, 1)
+void pairedStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real initial[kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ];
+    __shared__ Real middle[kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ];
+
+    const int tid = (threadIdx.z * kPairY + threadIdx.y) * kPairX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int threads = kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ;
+    const int coreX = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kPairX;
+    const int coreY = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kPairY;
+    const int coreZ = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kPairZ;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+
+    for (int linear = tid;
+         linear < kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ;
+         linear += threads) {
+        const int lx = linear % kPairInputX;
+        const int yz = linear / kPairInputX;
+        const int ly = yz % kPairInputY;
+        const int lz = yz / kPairInputY;
+        const int gx = max(0, min(coreX - 2 + lx, nx - 1));
+        const int gy = max(0, min(coreY - 2 + ly, ny - 1));
+        const int gz = max(0, min(coreZ - 2 + lz, nz - 1));
+        initial[linear] = input[static_cast<size_t>(gz) * plane
+                              + static_cast<size_t>(gy) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                              + static_cast<size_t>(gx)];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    for (int linear = tid;
+         linear < kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ;
+         linear += threads) {
+        const int lx = linear % kPairMiddleX;
+        const int yz = linear / kPairMiddleX;
+        const int ly = yz % kPairMiddleY;
+        const int lz = yz / kPairMiddleY;
+        const int gx = coreX - 1 + lx;
+        const int gy = coreY - 1 + ly;
+        const int gz = coreZ - 1 + lz;
+        const int center = ((lz + 1) * kPairInputY + ly + 1) * kPairInputX + lx + 1;
+
+        Real value = initial[center];
+        if (gx > 0 && gx < nx - 1 &&
+            gy > 0 && gy < ny - 1 &&
+            gz > 0 && gz < nz - 1) {
+            value += initial[center - 1];
+            value += initial[center + 1];
+            value += initial[center - kPairInputX];
+            value += initial[center + kPairInputX];
+            value += initial[center - kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
+            value += initial[center + kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
+            value /= 7.0;
+        }
+        middle[linear] = value;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int x = coreX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = coreY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = coreZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1 && z < nz - 1) {
+        const int center = ((threadIdx.z + 1) * kPairMiddleY + threadIdx.y + 1)
+                         * kPairMiddleX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+        Real value = middle[center];
+        value += middle[center - 1];
+        value += middle[center + 1];
+        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX];
+        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX];
+        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
+        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
+        const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                           + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                           + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+        output[index] = value / 7.0;
+    }
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_X
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_X 32
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectX = STENCIL_DIRECT_X;
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+constexpr int kPairX = 32;
+constexpr int kPairY = 8;
+constexpr int kPairZ = 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputX = kPairX + 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputY = kPairY + 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputZ = kPairZ + 4;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleX = kPairX + 2;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleY = kPairY + 2;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleZ = kPairZ + 2;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ, 1)
+void pairedStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real initial[kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ];
+    __shared__ Real middle[kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ];
+
+    const int tid = (threadIdx.z * kPairY + threadIdx.y) * kPairX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int threads = kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ;
+    const int coreX = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kPairX;
+    const int coreY = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kPairY;
+    const int coreZ = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kPairZ;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+
+    for (int linear = tid;
+         linear < kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ;
+         linear += threads) {
+        const int lx = linear % kPairInputX;
+        const int yz = linear / kPairInputX;
+        const int ly = yz % kPairInputY;
+        const int lz = yz / kPairInputY;
+        const int gx = max(0, min(coreX - 2 + lx, nx - 1));
+        const int gy = max(0, min(coreY - 2 + ly, ny - 1));
+        const int gz = max(0, min(coreZ - 2 + lz, nz - 1));
+        initial[linear] = input[static_cast<size_t>(gz) * plane
+                              + static_cast<size_t>(gy) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                              + static_cast<size_t>(gx)];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    for (int linear = tid;
+         linear < kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ;
+         linear += threads) {
+        const int lx = linear % kPairMiddleX;
+        const int yz = linear / kPairMiddleX;
+        const int ly = yz % kPairMiddleY;
+        const int lz = yz / kPairMiddleY;
+        const int gx = coreX - 1 + lx;
+        const int gy = coreY - 1 + ly;
+        const int gz = coreZ - 1 + lz;
+        const int center = ((lz + 1) * kPairInputY + ly + 1) * kPairInputX + lx + 1;
+
+        Real value = initial[center];
+        if (gx > 0 && gx < nx - 1 &&
+            gy > 0 && gy < ny - 1 &&
+            gz > 0 && gz < nz - 1) {
+            value += initial[center - 1];
+            value += initial[center + 1];
+            value += initial[center - kPairInputX];
+            value += initial[center + kPairInputX];
+            value += initial[center - kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
+            value += initial[center + kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
+            value /= 7.0;
+        }
+        middle[linear] = value;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int x = coreX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = coreY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = coreZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1 && z < nz - 1) {
+        const int center = ((threadIdx.z + 1) * kPairMiddleY + threadIdx.y + 1)
+                         * kPairMiddleX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+        Real value = middle[center];
+        value += middle[center - 1];
+        value += middle[center + 1];
+        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX];
+        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX];
+        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
+        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
+        const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                           + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                           + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+        output[index] = value / 7.0;
+    }
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
+// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
+// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
+constexpr int kTileX = 32;
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
+#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
+#endif
+constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
+constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_X
+#define STENCIL_DIRECT_X 32
+#endif
+constexpr int kDirectX = STENCIL_DIRECT_X;
+constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
+constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;
+
+constexpr int kPairX = 32;
+constexpr int kPairY = 8;
+constexpr int kPairZ = 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputX = kPairX + 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputY = kPairY + 4;
+constexpr int kPairInputZ = kPairZ + 4;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleX = kPairX + 2;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleY = kPairY + 2;
+constexpr int kPairMiddleZ = kPairZ + 2;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ, 1)
+void pairedStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real initial[kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ];
+    __shared__ Real middle[kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ];
+
+    const int tid = (threadIdx.z * kPairY + threadIdx.y) * kPairX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int threads = kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ;
+    const int coreX = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kPairX;
+    const int coreY = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kPairY;
+    const int coreZ = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kPairZ;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+
+    for (int linear = tid;
+         linear < kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ;
+         linear += threads) {
+        const int lx = linear % kPairInputX;
+        const int yz = linear / kPairInputX;
+        const int ly = yz % kPairInputY;
+        const int lz = yz / kPairInputY;
+        const int gx = max(0, min(coreX - 2 + lx, nx - 1));
+        const int gy = max(0, min(coreY - 2 + ly, ny - 1));
+        const int gz = max(0, min(coreZ - 2 + lz, nz - 1));
+        initial[linear] = input[static_cast<size_t>(gz) * plane
+                              + static_cast<size_t>(gy) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                              + static_cast<size_t>(gx)];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    for (int linear = tid;
+         linear < kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ;
+         linear += threads) {
+        const int lx = linear % kPairMiddleX;
+        const int yz = linear / kPairMiddleX;
+        const int ly = yz % kPairMiddleY;
+        const int lz = yz / kPairMiddleY;
+        const int gx = coreX - 1 + lx;
+        const int gy = coreY - 1 + ly;
+        const int gz = coreZ - 1 + lz;
+        const int center = ((lz + 1) * kPairInputY + ly + 1) * kPairInputX + lx + 1;
+
+        Real value = initial[center];
+        if (gx > 0 && gx < nx - 1 &&
+            gy > 0 && gy < ny - 1 &&
+            gz > 0 && gz < nz - 1) {
+            value += initial[center - 1];
+            value += initial[center + 1];
+            value += initial[center - kPairInputX];
+            value += initial[center + kPairInputX];
+            value += initial[center - kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
+            value += initial[center + kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
+            value /= 7.0;
+        }
+        middle[linear] = value;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int x = coreX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = coreY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = coreZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1 && z < nz - 1) {
+        const int center = ((threadIdx.z + 1) * kPairMiddleY + threadIdx.y + 1)
+                         * kPairMiddleX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+        Real value = middle[center];
+        value += middle[center - 1];
+        value += middle[center + 1];
+        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX];
+        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX];
+        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
+        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
+        const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                           + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                           + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+        output[index] = value / 7.0;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                          Real* __restrict__ output,
+                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+    if (y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            left = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            Real value = center;
+            value += left;
+            value += right;
+            value += input[index - nx];
+            value += input[index + nx];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
+void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output,
+                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
+    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
+    const int x = xBase + tx;
+    const int y = yBase + ty;
+    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
+    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
+    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
+    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
+
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
+        const int z = zFirst + dz;
+        if (z >= nz - 1) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const int buffer = dz & 1;
+        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
+        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
+            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
+            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
+            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
+            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
+        }
+
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
+            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
+            Real value = center;
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
+            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            value += below;
+            value += above;
+            output[index] = value / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        index += plane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace
+

// A block covers one x/y tile and a short z slab.  Keeping three z values in
// registers and caching the current x/y plane means that almost every input
// value is fetched from global memory only once per slab.
constexpr int kTileX = 32;
#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Y
#define STENCIL_TILE_Y 8
#endif
#ifndef STENCIL_TILE_Z
#define STENCIL_TILE_Z 16
#endif
constexpr int kTileY = STENCIL_TILE_Y;
constexpr int kTileZ = STENCIL_TILE_Z;

#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Y
#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Y 4
#endif
#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_Z
#define STENCIL_DIRECT_Z 2
#endif
#ifndef STENCIL_DIRECT_X
#define STENCIL_DIRECT_X 32
#endif
constexpr int kDirectX = STENCIL_DIRECT_X;
constexpr int kDirectY = STENCIL_DIRECT_Y;
constexpr int kDirectZ = STENCIL_DIRECT_Z;

constexpr int kPairX = 32;
constexpr int kPairY = 8;
constexpr int kPairZ = 4;
constexpr int kPairInputX = kPairX + 4;
constexpr int kPairInputY = kPairY + 4;
constexpr int kPairInputZ = kPairZ + 4;
constexpr int kPairMiddleX = kPairX + 2;
constexpr int kPairMiddleY = kPairY + 2;
constexpr int kPairMiddleZ = kPairZ + 2;

__global__ __launch_bounds__(kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ, 1)
void pairedStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
                         Real* __restrict__ output,
                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
    __shared__ Real initial[kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ];
    __shared__ Real middle[kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ];

    const int tid = (threadIdx.z * kPairY + threadIdx.y) * kPairX + threadIdx.x;
    const int threads = kPairX * kPairY * kPairZ;
    const int coreX = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kPairX;
    const int coreY = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kPairY;
    const int coreZ = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kPairZ;
    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);

    for (int linear = tid;
         linear < kPairInputX * kPairInputY * kPairInputZ;
         linear += threads) {
        const int lx = linear % kPairInputX;
        const int yz = linear / kPairInputX;
        const int ly = yz % kPairInputY;
        const int lz = yz / kPairInputY;
        const int gx = max(0, min(coreX - 2 + lx, nx - 1));
        const int gy = max(0, min(coreY - 2 + ly, ny - 1));
        const int gz = max(0, min(coreZ - 2 + lz, nz - 1));
        initial[linear] = input[static_cast<size_t>(gz) * plane
                              + static_cast<size_t>(gy) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                              + static_cast<size_t>(gx)];
    }
    __syncthreads();

    for (int linear = tid;
         linear < kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY * kPairMiddleZ;
         linear += threads) {
        const int lx = linear % kPairMiddleX;
        const int yz = linear / kPairMiddleX;
        const int ly = yz % kPairMiddleY;
        const int lz = yz / kPairMiddleY;
        const int gx = coreX - 1 + lx;
        const int gy = coreY - 1 + ly;
        const int gz = coreZ - 1 + lz;
        const int center = ((lz + 1) * kPairInputY + ly + 1) * kPairInputX + lx + 1;

        Real value = initial[center];
        if (gx > 0 && gx < nx - 1 &&
            gy > 0 && gy < ny - 1 &&
            gz > 0 && gz < nz - 1) {
            value += initial[center - 1];
            value += initial[center + 1];
            value += initial[center - kPairInputX];
            value += initial[center + kPairInputX];
            value += initial[center - kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
            value += initial[center + kPairInputX * kPairInputY];
            value /= 7.0;
        }
        middle[linear] = value;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    const int x = coreX + threadIdx.x;
    const int y = coreY + threadIdx.y;
    const int z = coreZ + threadIdx.z;
    if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1 && z < nz - 1) {
        const int center = ((threadIdx.z + 1) * kPairMiddleY + threadIdx.y + 1)
                         * kPairMiddleX + threadIdx.x + 1;
        Real value = middle[center];
        value += middle[center - 1];
        value += middle[center + 1];
        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX];
        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX];
        value += middle[center - kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
        value += middle[center + kPairMiddleX * kPairMiddleY];
        const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
                           + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                           + static_cast<size_t>(x);
        output[index] = value / 7.0;
    }
}

__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
void shuffleStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
                          Real* __restrict__ output,
                          const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
    const int x = xBase + tx;
    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY + threadIdx.y;
    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;
    if (y >= ny - 1) {
        return;
    }

    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
    const bool active = x < nx - 1;
    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);
    Real below = input[index - plane];
    Real center = input[index];

#pragma unroll
    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
        const int z = zFirst + dz;
        if (z >= nz - 1) {
            break;
        }

        const Real above = input[index + plane];
        Real left = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
        Real right = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, center, 1);
        if (tx == 0) {
            left = input[index - 1];
        }
        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
            right = input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
                        + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                        + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
        }

        if (active) {
            Real value = center;
            value += left;
            value += right;
            value += input[index - nx];
            value += input[index + nx];
            value += below;
            value += above;
            output[index] = value / 7.0;
        }
        below = center;
        center = above;
        index += plane;
    }
}

__global__ __launch_bounds__(kDirectX * kDirectY * kDirectZ)
void directStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
                         Real* __restrict__ output,
                         const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kDirectX + threadIdx.x;
    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kDirectY + threadIdx.y;
    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kDirectZ + threadIdx.z;
    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
        return;
    }

    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
    Real value = input[index];
    value += input[index - 1];
    value += input[index + 1];
    value += input[index - nx];
    value += input[index + nx];
    value += input[index - plane];
    value += input[index + plane];
    output[index] = value / 7.0;
}

__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTileX * kTileY)
void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
                   Real* __restrict__ output,
                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
    __shared__ Real tile[2][kTileY + 2][kTileX + 2];

    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
    const int xBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileX;
    const int yBase = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileY;
    const int x = xBase + tx;
    const int y = yBase + ty;
    const int zFirst = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kTileZ;

    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still participate in barriers and
    // populate shared memory with the nearest boundary value.
    const int xLoad = x < nx ? x : nx - 1;
    const int yLoad = y < ny ? y : ny - 1;
    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(zFirst) * plane
                 + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                 + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad);

    Real below = input[index - plane];
    Real center = input[index];

#pragma unroll
    for (int dz = 0; dz < kTileZ; ++dz) {
        const int z = zFirst + dz;
        if (z >= nz - 1) {
            break;
        }

        const Real above = input[index + plane];
        const int buffer = dz & 1;
        tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;

        // Only the perimeter threads fetch the four x/y halo strips.  The
        // coordinates are clamped for partial tiles at the upper edges.
        if (tx == 0) {
            tile[buffer][ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
        }
        if (tx == kTileX - 1) {
            const int haloX = min(xBase + kTileX, nx - 1);
            tile[buffer][ty + 1][kTileX + 1] =
                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
                    + static_cast<size_t>(yLoad) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloX)];
        }
        if (ty == 0) {
            tile[buffer][0][tx + 1] =
                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
                    + static_cast<size_t>(yBase - 1) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
        }
        if (ty == kTileY - 1) {
            const int haloY = min(yBase + kTileY, ny - 1);
            tile[buffer][kTileY + 1][tx + 1] =
                input[static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
                    + static_cast<size_t>(haloY) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                    + static_cast<size_t>(xLoad)];
        }

        __syncthreads();

        if (active) {
            // Keep the same left-to-right operation order as the scalar
            // implementation so CUDA and CPU results agree bit-for-bit.
            Real value = center;
            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx];
            value += tile[buffer][ty + 1][tx + 2];
            value += tile[buffer][ty][tx + 1];
            value += tile[buffer][ty + 2][tx + 1];
            value += below;
            value += above;
            output[index] = value / 7.0;
        }

        below = center;
        center = above;
        index += plane;
    }
}

bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
        return true;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
            cudaGetErrorString(status));
    return false;
}

} // namespace

// 3D index calculation
inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {
    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;
}

void initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                grid[idx] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;
            }
        }
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {
    // Simple sanity checks
    
    // 1. No NaN or Inf values
    for (const auto& val : grid) {
        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {
            printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)
    Real minVal = grid[0];
    Real maxVal = grid[0];
    for (const auto& val : grid) {
        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);
        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);
    }
    
    printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", minVal, maxVal);
    
    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded
    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {

+    const int coreY = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kPairY;

 using Real = double;
 
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr int kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr int kBlockZ = 2;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace
+

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+

+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

using Real = double;

namespace {

constexpr int kBlockX = 32;
constexpr int kBlockY = 4;
constexpr int kBlockZ = 2;

__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
                   Real* __restrict__ output,
                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z;
    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
        return;
    }

    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
    Real value = input[index];
    value += input[index - 1];
    value += input[index + 1];
    value += input[index - nx];
    value += input[index + nx];
    value += input[index - plane];
    value += input[index + plane];
    output[index] = value / 7.0;
}

bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
        return true;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
            cudaGetErrorString(status));
    return false;
}

} // namespace

// 3D index calculation
inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {
    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;
}

void initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                grid[idx] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;
            }
        }
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {
    // Simple sanity checks
    
    // 1. No NaN or Inf values
    for (const auto& val : grid) {
        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {
            printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)
    Real minVal = grid[0];
    Real maxVal = grid[0];
    for (const auto& val : grid) {
        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);
        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);
    }
    
    printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", minVal, maxVal);
    
    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded
    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {
        printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
        return false;
    }
    
    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly
    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)
    
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\n");
    printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    printf("  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

    size_t nx = 128;
    size_t ny = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified
    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified
    int iterations = 10;
    bool validate = false;

            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);

            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
        std::swap(input, output);
    }
#else
    for (; iter < iterations; ++iter) {
        if (hasInterior) {

            directStencilKernel<<<blocks, block>>>(input, output,

                                                   static_cast<int>(ny),
                                                   static_cast<int>(nz));
#elif defined(STENCIL_USE_SHUFFLE)
            shuffleStencilKernel<<<blocks, block>>>(input, output,
                                                    static_cast<int>(nx),
                                                    static_cast<int>(ny),

    if (!cudaSucceeded(cudaStatus, "stencil execution")) {

    const double interiorZ = nz > 2 ? static_cast<double>(nz - 2) : 0.0;
    const double cellUpdates = interiorX * interiorY * interiorZ * iterations;
    const double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second
    printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);

    if (!cudaSucceeded(cudaMemcpy(grid1.data(), input, gridBytes,

        cudaFree(deviceGrid1);
        cudaFree(deviceGrid2);

    }
    cudaFree(deviceGrid1);
    cudaFree(deviceGrid2);
    
    // Print results for external validation
    const std::vector<Real>& finalGrid = grid1;
    if (printResults) {
        print_results(finalGrid, "Grid");
    }
    
    // Validation
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating result...\n");
        bool valid = validateResult(finalGrid, nx, ny, nz);
        
        if (valid) {
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {

        }

 using Real = double;
 
+namespace {
+
+constexpr int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr int kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr int kBlockZ = 2;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+constexpr int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr int kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr int kBlockZ = 2;
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
+}
+
+bool cudaSucceeded(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    return false;
+}
+
+} // namespace

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {

+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z;

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {

+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z;

+// X spans one complete warp for coalesced loads and stores.  The y/z extent
+// supplies enough independent warps to hide memory latency while neighboring
+// blocks naturally reuse stencil planes through the read-only/L2 caches.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
 }

+// blocks naturally reuse stencil planes through the read-only/L2 caches.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {
+    const int x = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const int z = 1 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.z) * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = static_cast<size_t>(nx) * static_cast<size_t>(ny);
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * plane
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * static_cast<size_t>(nx)
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+    Real value = input[index];
+    value += input[index - 1];
+    value += input[index + 1];
+    value += input[index - nx];
+    value += input[index + nx];
+    value += input[index - plane];
+    value += input[index + plane];
+    output[index] = value / 7.0;
